autonomy_scope: parse user prompt into structured requirements
select a robot morphology template from an extensible template catalog
select parts from curated component database
generate robot genome and CAD handoff
compile generated scenes into simulator XML placeholders
emit simulator-ready curriculum and dry-run traces

decisions.rationale: Selected morph_fixed_arm_three_dof_tabletop because task_type=pick_place_sort, environment=tabletop, and prompt='a tabletop robot arm that sorts red and blue blocks into matching bins' matched robot_class=manipulator. This template supports task_type=pick_place_sort and keeps the MVP bounded while preserving a catalog route for mobile bases, humanoids, and future robot classes.

decisions.decision: Select joint_actuator:VX-12 Smart Servo, wrist_sensor:RGBD Mini Wrist Camera, gripper:PG-2 Parallel Gripper, main_compute:EDGE-1 Robotics Compute Module
decisions.rationale: Parts satisfy named user requests when present, otherwise use requirement-aware recommendations.

decisions.decision: Generate 5 CAD model records and 5 assembly instances.
decisions.rationale: The MVP keeps exact geometry, parametric source, visual meshes, and assembly operations as separate handoffs; estimated printed mass is 0.925 kg.

decisions.decision: Generate scene families for pick_place_sort: baseline:2, variation:10, edge_case:3, regression:3, holdout:3.
decisions.rationale: Scene families separate smoke tests, training variation, failure replay, and holdout generalization.

decisions.decision: Use measurable task criteria as reward, termination, curriculum, and trace contracts for pick_place_sort.
decisions.rationale: A real simulator runner can replace the dry-run adapter while keeping the same artifact inputs.

handoffs.description: Resolve named or recommended components with technical limits and CAD asset references.
Build structured robot genome, parametric CAD source, exact placeholder assembly, and visual meshes.
Generate train/evaluate scene families from task criteria, failures, and holdout coverage.
Run a deterministic simulator-adapter dry run over generated scenes and policy steps.

open_limitations: CAD and MJCF are structured placeholders, not physics-validated production geometry yet.
Dry-run training validates package contracts but does not execute real dynamics.
Part database is curated fixture data; live datasheet ingestion is still future work.
